description: This file defines a singleton object 'ThemeUtils' which manages theme-related functionalities such as applying themes, checking if dark mode is active, and toggling themes in an Android application. It includes an internal enum class 'Theme' with options for LIGHT, DARK, and SYSTEM themes.

classes.name: ThemeUtils
classes.description: Singleton object providing theme management utilities for toggling and applying light/dark/system themes.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Enumeration of available theme modes: LIGHT, DARK, SYSTEM.

methods.name: applyTheme
methods.description: Sets the application's theme mode based on the specifiedTheme parameter.

methods.name: isDarkMode
methods.description: Checks if the current theme mode is dark.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches between light and dark themes.
